title: Hypoglycemia
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Monitor glucose and potassium during insulin and report low values immediately.

expected_actions.text: Increase the frequency of blood glucose monitoring in patients at higher risk of hypoglycaemia and monitor potassium.
Report low or rapidly falling glucose immediately.
